served_class_order_note: ALPHABETICAL, read back from model.names and written to the sidecar. Ultralytics indexes a classification head by sorted directory name, so this is not the config's order and must never be assumed to be. The service reads the sidecar.
winner_note: the SHIPPED DEFAULTS - U8S8, per-channel, minmax, stretched calibration. It was eligible on the first variant, so the pre-registered sweep never ran and no other configuration was tried

not_gates.unknown_note: 0.55 is an uncalibrated guess and max-softmax is a baseline, not a principled score. An unknown rate of 0.0 over 47 in-distribution crops is a property of that guess as much as of the model. docs/12 P2 replaces it

resolution.note: the splits are small enough that the accuracy gate's RESOLUTION is about the size of the gate. This is a fact about the measurement, not about the model
resolution.means: on 56 val crops a single extra misclassification is 0.018, so this measurement can only distinguish 'int8 and fp32 differ by at most one crop' from 'they differ by two or more'

confidence.note: 47/47 is not 1.000 with certainty. Rule of three, 95 %
confidence.igloo_in_test: 3 crops from 2 capture clusters - says essentially nothing

gate_result.accuracy: PASS - int8 drop 0.0000 against a budget of 0.02
gate_result.latency: UNMEASURED - the bench has not run
